name: experience-cms
description: Author and source media for Experience Cloud content: apply CMS branding, generate CMS content, search existing Salesforce CMS or Data 360 media, and search and download ethically licensed stock imagery through Salesforce media-management tooling. Use when producing or branding CMS content for a Digital Experience site, locating an existing content asset, or finding a stock image for a page. Also render accessible CMS-managed images, video, audio, and documents in React experiences.

interface.shortDescription: Author and source media for Experience Cloud content
